name: Black Cultural Archives
ownershipEvidence: The official site states that it is a national heritage institution dedicated to histories of people of African and Caribbean descent in the UK; Visit London independently lists the Windrush Square address and describes its archive, library and exhibitions.
notes: Cultural place, not a commercial map pin. The official site and Visit London show the same visitor address; no claim about current access or opening times is made here.

name: Chishuru
